testModificationPermission.note: YES, only when required in a later implementation phase; preserve meaningful assertions and do not weaken tests merely to make them pass.

gaps.title: No CI workflow to build/lint/test backend + frontend
gaps.description:
No .github/workflows/ directory evidenced in repo root; no pipeline to run backend build/tests and frontend build/lint.
\nEvidence: repo root listing lacks .github/workflows/.

gaps.title: No containerization for running full stack
gaps.description:
No Dockerfile or docker-compose files evidenced in repo root; Apparent run flow is backend (Maven) + frontend (npm) separately.

Evidence: repo root listing lacks Dockerfile/docker-compose.

gaps.title: No frontend automated tests configured
gaps.description:
frontend/package.json has scripts for dev/build/lint/preview but no test script and no evidenced test framework dependencies (e.g., vitest/jest/playwright).

Evidence: frontend/package.json.

gaps.title: Missing integration-level tests for persistence layer
gaps.description:
Existing tests are app-context smoke and controller slice test with mocked TodoService, so they do not hit SQLite/repository behavior. In particular, backend/src/test/java/com/example/todo/controller/TodoControllerTest.java uses @WebMvcTest and ` @MockitoBean TodoService`.
\nEvidence: backend/src/test/java/../TodoControllerTest.java, backend/src/test/java/.../TodoApplicationTests.java.

gaps.title: No machine-readable API contract (OpenAPI/Swagger)
gaps.description:
backend/pom.xml does not include an OpenAPI/Swagger generation dependency (eg, springdoc-openapi); API is documented only in human-readable README.md.

Evidence: backend/pom.xml, README.md.

gaps.title: No authentication/authorization protecting API
gaps.description:
No Spring Security dependency evidenced in backend/pom.xml; controller exposes public CRUD endpoints under /api/todos.
\nEvidence: backend/pom.xml, backend/src/main/java/../TodoController.java.

gaps.title: CORS policy not explicitly defined for non-dev usage
gaps.description:
frontend/vite.config.ts uses a dev proxy for /api to http://localhost:8080. No backend CORS policy config class reviewed in backend/src/main/java/com/example/todo/config (contains only DataSourceInitializer.java).

Evidence: frontend/vite.config.ts, backend/src/main/java/../config/DataSourceInitializer.java.

gaps.title: Config not parameterized (DB url, port, profiles)
gaps.description:
backend/src/main/resources/application.yml hardcodes `jdbc:sqlite:./data/todo.db` and `server.port: 8080`. No profile-specific YML or env-var documentation evidenced.

Evidence: backend/src/main/resources/application.yml.

gaps.title: No documented seed/reset data lifecycle for dev/test
gaps.description:
Flyway migration exists (backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__create_todos_table.sql) and runtime creates ./data directory (backend/src/main/java/.../config/DataSourceInitializer.java), but no seeding scripts, test fixtures, or reset tooling/docs evidenced.
\nEvidence: backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__create_todos_table.sql; backend/src/main/java/.../config/DataSourceInitializer.java.

gaps.title: No health/metrics endpoints (Actuator)
gaps.description:
No spring-boot-starter-actuator dependency evidenced in backend/pom.xml; no health endpoint config/docs evidenced.

Evidence: backend/pom.xml.

gaps.title: Limited developer documentation beyond basic run steps
gaps.description:
Root README.md provides basic run instructions and an API table; no dedicated documentation tree / architecture notes/workflows evidenced (pre-patch).
\nEvidence: README.md; initial repo root listing lacked docs/.

gaps.title: No root-level unified workflow (one-command build/test/run)
gaps.description: Backend and frontend are separate (Maven in backend/, npm in frontend/) and no root-scoped scripts/tooling were evidenced to unify build/test/run.
